props.caption: The mandatory fallback — live OCT is the cherry, never the dependency.

props.markdown:
## How this page builds itself

This static React SPA dynamically adapts to its underlying layout specification. By using Zod validation at runtime, the layout components are safely rendered based on a declarative configuration tree.

- Validates the layout specification at runtime using Zod.
- Fetches updates asynchronously with automatic fallback.
- Preserves offline-first capability through baked snapshot.

| Loop | Gate |
| --- | --- |
| Static Loop | Commit Gate |
| Live Loop | Fetch Timeout |
